output.population: Patient admissions to the Department of Intensive Care Medicine of the Bern University Hospital, an interdisciplinary 60-bed adult unit, from January 2008 to June 2016
output.summary: High time-resolution intensive care database from a Swiss university hospital, with de-identified demographics plus routinely collected physiological variables, diagnostic test results and treatment parameters recorded every two minutes during ICU admissions.
